title: FOUNDATIONS OF PERSONAL FINANCE I
description: Part of Blueprint – a 12 course professional development course series to guide the student from college to career. First of four courses dedicated to the foundations of personal finances. Topics include basics of personal finances and resources available; setting academic plan; setting strategic financial goals; budgeting.
registration_restrictions:
Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in:

  • Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075)
  • Business Administration (181)
  • Finance (182)
  • Business Information Systems (183)
  • Accountancy (641)
  • Marketing (799)
  • Business Analytics (899)
  • Organizational Leadership (A018)
  • Innovation & Entrepreneurship (A039)
  • Sports Business (A050)
meeting_html: W 2pm-2:50pm in MLM 236 - Milam Hall 236 (9/23 to 12/4)
